name: Artistry (Combat)
body:
You can do more with your blade than slash and stab.

Prerequisite(s): Exotic Weapon Proficiency (dueling sword), Weapon Finesse, base attack bonus +2.

Benefit(s): Choose one of the following combat maneuvers: disarm, reposition, steal, sunder, or trip. You gain a +2 bonus when performing the selected maneuver while wielding a dueling sword. This bonus does not stack with the bonus provided by a combat maneuver feat with -improved- in its name (such as Improved Trip).

Special: You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different combat maneuver each time.
